properties.description: Detects when JA4proxy has flagged a source IP for beaconing behaviour — periodic connections with low inter-arrival time variance, characteristic of C2 check-in traffic. Correlates with MITRE ATT&CK T1071 (Application Layer Protocol).
properties.query:
JA4proxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where ja4proxy_action_s in ('blocked', 'banned', 'flagged')
| where RawData has 'beaconing_detected'
| extend signals = parse_json(extract('"ja4proxy.signals":\\s*(\\[.*?\\])', 1, RawData))
| mv-expand signal = signals
| where tostring(signal.name) == 'beaconing_detected'
| summarize
    EventCount = count(),
    MaxScore = max(ja4proxy_risk_score_d),
    SNIList = make_set(ja4proxy_sni_s, 10),
    Actions = make_set(ja4proxy_action_s, 5)
    by source_ip_s, ja4proxy_fingerprint_s, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where EventCount >= 3
| extend
    AlertTitle = strcat('Beaconing detected from ', source_ip_s, ' (', EventCount, ' events, score=', MaxScore, ')'),
    SourceIP = source_ip_s,
    JA4Fingerprint = ja4proxy_fingerprint_s

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Beaconing detected from {{source_ip_s}} — {{EventCount}} periodic connections with low IAT variance. Max risk score: {{MaxScore}}.
